drivers.detail: Mandatory HUID hallmarking expanded to 380 districts (6th phase, Mar-2026); a 28-Apr-2026 amendment reportedly consolidates 385 districts. BIS-registered jewellers 1.94 lakh (Nov-2024) vs 43k (Jul-2021). Organised share 37-42% FY26 -> 45-50% FY30 (CRISIL).
Union Budget 23-Jul-2024 cut gold customs duty to 6% (BCD 5% + AIDC 1%); lifted H2-2024 demand, narrowed India-UAE price gap; caused one-off inventory losses for jewellers then.

BCD 10% + AIDC 5% to defend rupee/forex. ICRA expects industry volumes -~15% in FY27 and higher working-capital intensity; WGC sees 50-60t demand loss. Short-term inventory gains: Kalyan Rs 41 cr in Q1FY27 + ~Rs 60 cr expected Q2FY27; Titan Rs 407 cr Q1FY27. Smuggling risk rises.

drivers.theme: PM Modi appeal to defer gold purchases (10-May-2026, repeated ~Aug/Sep-2026)
drivers.detail: PM asked citizens to postpone gold purchases for a year amid West Asia crisis/forex pressure; jewellery stocks fell 6-12% on 11-May-2026; Kalyan fell again ~6.8% on 1-Sep-2026 after a repeat appeal. WGC cited it for Q2-2026 weakness.

drivers.theme: Gold price volatility: volume vs value
drivers.detail: Volumes falling (2025 jewellery -24% t; Q1-26 -19%; Q2-26 -15%) while value at records. Organised players still posting 20-40% revenue growth on price. Management: buyers shop by budget, so lower gold prices lift grams; price-shock pauses last 2-3 weeks. Recycled/exchange gold 46% of Kalyan Q1FY27 revenue (>55% in June) - margin dilutive 20-30bps.
WGC notes consumers shifting to lighter, lower-karat and studded pieces to manage cost; higher margin for retailers. Kalyan India studded share slipped to 28% (Q1FY27) from 30%.

LGD export price fell from USD 389/ct (2022) to USD 71/ct (Jan-May 2026); deflation pressures natural diamond-studded pricing and invites new LGD-focused competitors; also an opportunity for affordable studded lines.
Wedding demand is non-deferrable; Adhik Maas (Q1FY27) and Navratri shift (Q2FY27 vs Q2FY26) moved quarterly comps; Titan said festive calendar shifted into Q3FY27.

RBI GML Directions (effective 1-Apr-2026 per secondary sources): import-linked vs GMS-linked GML, 270-day tenor cap, daily LBMA valuation, banks set own quantity limits. Kalyan GML Rs 3,588 cr FY26 (MOFSL). Final text status not verified.
3% GST on gold jewellery unchanged per general knowledge; no 2026 change found.
